basics.name: Maciej Płusa
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | UX & Architecture | Technical Leadership
basics.summary: Engineering leader with 15+ years of experience delivering scalable web applications and leading cross-functional development teams. Built and scaled engineering teams of up to 5 developers from scratch, owned full-cycle recruitment and onboarding, and led enterprise engagements serving high-traffic production systems. Drove major performance optimizations including UI rewrites delivering 15x improvements and 50% bundle size reduction, while ensuring predictable agile delivery and strong stakeholder alignment.

work.name: Unikie Oy
work.summary: Global software engineering company delivering intelligent digital solutions for enterprise clients. Led engineering initiatives for large-scale e-commerce and industrial platforms while building and scaling a new delivery team in Poland.
highlights: Built and led a new engineering team of 5 developers in Poland for an enterprise client engagement.
Owned the full recruitment pipeline including sourcing, technical interviews, evaluation, and hiring decisions.
Established onboarding processes, engineering standards, and collaboration workflows.
Served as primary technical point of contact for enterprise clients, maintaining continuous communication and delivery alignment.
Led roadmap planning together with Product Owners and ensured predictable sprint execution.
Rewrote critical UI components for a large-scale e-commerce platform, achieving performance improvements exceeding 15x.
Improved rendering efficiency and responsiveness in high-traffic production systems.
Delivered and maintained enterprise-grade industrial applications used in global production environments.
Mentored engineers and conducted structured code reviews to maintain high quality standards.
Successfully transitioned application maintenance responsibilities to the newly formed Polish team.
